headline: Nevish Line Surges as Contested Fronts Shift
war_summary: Since the last edition, Nevish Line has become the war’s busiest ledger, rising to 69 base events in 24 hours, including 20 in the latest two; Princefal, Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother, and Blinding Stones remain the principal trouble spots. Weathered Expanse has eased to 51 daily events from the previous 52, with only one in the latest two hours, though its ownership remains divided and casualties are accelerating sharply. Kuura Strand now records 28 events in the current 24-hour window, with two in the latest two hours and Faden Point and Talven still the chief scenes of movement. Marban Hollow likewise stands at 28 events, down from the prior edition’s 32, and has seen no fresh event in six hours. Linn Mercy holds at 11 events, while Godcrofts remains at six; neither reports new action in the latest two hours. Stlican Shelf has three events and heavy, accelerating casualties, but no recent base movement. Elsewhere, several sectors show rising enlistment or casualty rates without recorded ownership events. The war remains undecided.
